errors.text_span: 该饼图旨在展示男性动词语义域的分布情况。
errors.evidence: The figure is not a single pie chart, but a main pie chart on the left where one slice ('其他' - Other) is exploded into a secondary, more detailed pie chart on the right. The description completely misses this two-part structure and treats it as a single chart.

The description claims there are 16 slices in total. However, the figure displays 17 unique categories across the two charts (8 in the main chart, with the 'Other' category replaced by the 10 categories in the secondary chart).
The description identifies the slice with 8.51% as '身体' (Body). The chart clearly labels this slice as '判断' (Judgment).
The description assigns the value 4.26% to the category '判断' (Judgment). In the chart, '判断' is 8.51%.
The description identifies the slice with 5.32% as '表达' (Expression). The chart labels this slice as '表情' (Facial Expression).
The description identifies the slice with 18.09% as '方式改变' (Change of method). The chart labels this slice as '方位改变' (Change of direction/position).
The description assigns the value 9.57% to the category '帮助' (Help). In the chart, '帮助' is 4.26%. The value 9.57% actually corresponds to '争斗' (Struggle).
The description uses the label '文本' (text) for the 5.57% slice. The chart's actual label is '文教' (Culture & Education).
